basic_info.description: Utterly Charming Inner Parkside/West Portal Home just a short stroll to vibrant West Portal Village shops, restaurants, and Muni access. Elegant Living Room with soaring ceilings, wood-burning fireplace, period crown moldings, and gleaming hardwood floors. Formal Dining Room overlooking a serene center patio, ideal for entertaining or everyday dining.    Sunny Breakfast Room with original built-in hutch, adjacent to a updated kitchen SS appliances and charming/period tile counters.    Spacious renovated bathroom with dual sink vanity and custom tile/shower over tub.    Two Generously Sized Bedrooms on the main floor, both overlooking the large, fenced backyard with mature landscaping.    Lower-Level Bonus Room ideal for a home office, guest suite, or family/media room, with adjacent garage access and quarter bath.    Extensive System Upgrades including seismic retrofit, new furnace (2021), Nest thermostat and doorbell, and chimney restoration.    Fresh Interior & Exterior Enhancements such as garage epoxy floor, new garage door, updated lighting, and custom painting inside and out.    Beautiful Period Details Throughout paired with thoughtful modern updates, making this a rare move-in ready gem in a highly desirable neighborhood.
